validation.pinned_corpus: passed; all four full report bytes and every individual outcome unchanged, no baseline regeneration
validation.clippy_warnings_denied: passed after removing an unused test helper; release tests cover the final test source
validation.frontend: Type/build checks pass. Production/local/served hashes match; noun-suffix source after adnominal ㄴ is 88924, bound-noun hint uses compatible 71124, and 둥이 uses 72336.
validation.full_browser: passed after correcting the test fixture reference; all 100 API cases, suffix/bound-noun identities, complete lexical slots, three exports and mobile checks pass
validation.rendering: Packaged desktop/mobile screenshots visually inspected; ordered noun/copula components fit without horizontal overflow. Dictionary hints are not contextually selected senses.
validation.packaged_api: All 100 cases raw/both filters, word/text HTTP/CLI parity, all lexical assessment slots, nine bound-noun homonyms, complete suffix senses/44 groups and spacing roles pass.
validation.preview: Exact previous process verified/exited twice; final port 8081 package identity/start time recorded. All-case API and three browser exports pass.

browser_regression.before: New suffix-label regression fails against original immutable packaged UI: noun suffix after ㄴ has no Noun-forming suffix label.
browser_regression.after: Finite adnominal ownership selects noun-only label/source 88924; independently assessed bound noun selects 71124. Both pass under all three filters.

public_contract.ownership: Adnominal ending belongs to the predicate inside the listed noun formation. Bound noun/suffix owns outer plural, approximation and particles. Later copula owns its own inflections.
public_contract.dictionary_policy: All nine 이 entries remain; known non-bound-noun homonyms receive a lexical-role conflict only in the explicitly bound-noun path. Both filters exclude unmatched 못난/흰둥 Roots; both detailed analyses remain.
public_contract.spacing: Listed noun formations do not become predicate segments in spacing suggestions.

limitations: Source-pattern structural judgments do not certify exclusive histories, contextual senses or overall precision. Ten raw/six per-filter additions retain unjudged IDs.
NIKL 2023 bound-noun and September 2026 suffix answers coexist without priority by date. Whole-base Root hypotheses do not certify missing headword POS.
Complete pinned 둥이 nominal-base class note remains; separate primary norms evidence licenses only finite 흰둥이. Current source retrieval failures are distinguished from historical primary consultation.

Two novel occurrences add six raw/four filtered paths. Original contexts and all previous candidates/readings are retained; contextual senses stay unjudged. The novel outputs are therefore not byte-identical.
Five original formation cases, other compounds/lexical classes, finer histories and independent Korean review remain required.
Three interleaved local release timing/RSS samples include startup, lookup and JSONL serialization; they are descriptive, not statistical equivalence or universal throughput guarantees.
